scenes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animated VFX sprite sheet for a realistic painted fantasy tactical strategy game. Primary request: Restorative holy healing: emerald and pale gold motes spiral upward into a luminous translucent blossom of life, then settle into gentle healing sparks. Create ONE complete square sprite atlas, EXACTLY 6 columns by 6 rows, 36 equally sized square cells. Read order left to right then top to bottom is a single smooth animation from anticipation through bloom to dissipation. Each cell contains ONLY the magic effect on genuinely transparent alpha; no character, no scene, no ground, no shadow plane, no background. Consistent fixed center in every cell, the entire effect fits inside its own cell with transparent gutters, absolutely no overlapping adjacent cells. Hand-painted realistic fantasy game effect, rich fine filaments, soft luminous edges, strong readable silhouette at small scale. First frames restrained, middle frames fullest, final frames visibly dissipating. No labels, no cell borders, no watermark. Square sheet, preferably 1536 by 1536 pixels, compatible with a 6 by 6 regular grid.
